task.name: Set_up_camp_furniture
task.when: During Build after shade and public-area structures pass inspection

step.action: Confirm the current furniture locations, assembly pages, hardware counts, and final-state photographs in 📦 Build_Book.
Assemble each Playatech bench and swing according to its printed page.
Have the Build Lead test each assembled bench and swing for movement or instability.
step.ifThen: IF furniture moves, rocks, binds, or has a missing connection, THEN keep it out of service.

step.action: Place benches, swings, chairs, rugs, and cushions in their mapped positions.
Clear every walking path, service lane, and emergency exit.

passWhen.criterion: Every assembled bench and swing matches its drawing and is stable.
Every furniture group is in its mapped position.
No path, service lane, or emergency exit is blocked.
